title: •Hiding In The Garbage
caption: •Hiding In The Garbage (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Place your just lost characters out of play. Once per turn, may deploy a character from Lost Pile. (Immune to your Alter.)
lore: Rebels often exploit loopholes in Imperial procedures to gain an advantage.
